de.title: Phrasal Verbs 3: call off, find out, give up und mehr
de.intro: Sieben häufige Phrasal Verbs mit deutscher Bedeutung und einem Beispielsatz.

cards.back: absagen, abbrechen. The organisers called off the concert because of the storm.
herausfinden, erfahren. I will find out when the train leaves.
aufgeben, mit etwas aufhören. They gave up the search when it got dark.
kurz warten („Moment mal“). Hold on, I will get my coat.
sich an etwas festhalten (mit Objekt). Hold on to the railing.
etwas prüfen oder untersuchen. The team will look into the cause of the error.
auf etwas hinweisen. She pointed out that the deadline had changed.

en.title: Phrasal Verbs 3: call off, find out, give up and more
en.intro: Seven common phrasal verbs with their meaning and an example sentence.

cards.back: to cancel or stop something planned. The organisers called off the concert because of the storm.
to discover or learn something. I will find out when the train leaves.
to stop doing something, or to quit trying. They gave up the search when it got dark.
to wait for a short moment. Hold on, I will get my coat.
to grip something firmly (takes an object). Hold on to the railing.
to investigate or examine something. The team will look into the cause of the error.
to tell someone about a fact or remind them of it. She pointed out that the deadline had changed.
